metric_definitions.inspected_batches: Twenty disposable one-negative batches using independent seed-42-derived local sampling streams.
metric_definitions.invalid_target_positions: Selected positions failing reserved-mask, catalog-label, catalog-negative or positive/negative inequality checks.
metric_definitions.valid_masked_targets: Number of audited positions contributing measured margins.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative logit on training-exposed masked targets; score-scale sensitive, not validation performance.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank tenth percentile of those margins.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of those margins below zero; invariant to common positive score rescaling.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of those margins below 0.5; score-scale sensitive.
metric_definitions.unavailable_reason: Measurement limitation when coverage is zero; zero coverage is not a passing result.

masked_target_diagnostics.scope: Selected category checkpoint, independent training-sample instrumentation. Does not certify original event provenance, fresh-process predictor parity or held-out usefulness. Existing diagnosis_tools APIs remain unchanged.
